summary_1line: Rama begins his final Mahaprasthana, leading a vast, joyful procession of gods, sages, citizens, and creatures toward the Sarayu and heaven.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama walks barefoot toward the Sarayu River at dawn, holding kusha grass, with Lakshmi on his right, a goddess on his left, and celestial weapons following in human form.
An immense procession of citizens, monkeys, bears, sages, and animals joyfully follows Rama out of Ayodhya as the city empties behind them.
The Vedas personified as Brahmins and sacred symbols like AUM and Gayatri move in Rama’s radiant train toward the open gates of heaven.
